items.notes:
tldr order
Best: All of A&C -> F-R until 578 -> -ZR-
Alt: All of A&C -> all of F-R

Episodes 1-206: 
A&C is R2J DVD Encode+Modified leorio (adjusted timing, added OP/ED and title card styling)

Episodes 207-452: 
A&C is old FUNI JPN WEBRip+modified CR. ED 14 and 15 were restored from HDTV caps and recap scenes were replaced by R2J DVD video. OP12 is an NCOP from the BD.

Episodes 453-458: 
A&C is ABEMA, AMZN, and VideoMarket WEBRip+modified CR. SD recaps replaced by R2J DVD video, and HD recaps by their own encodes. OP12 is an NCOP from the BD.
Production switches to VFR at 453 but old 24fps OP is used through 458. CR JPN stays at 24fps and is a stuttery mess, CR ENG/FUNI update to 30fps at 471 and revert back at 575, AMZN updates to 30fps at 454 (but now the OP is wrong), reverts for 457-458 (OP right again, episode wrong except flashbacks), and back again at 459 (new OP)

Episodes 459-470: 
F-R is AMZN WEBRip+CR. Missing a signs track for the dub
AMZN was re-encoded to fix bad deinterlacing, the cure is arguably worse than the disease but they at least handle the VFR

Episodes 471-574:
FR is CR ENG WEBRip+CR
Only the OP is re-encoded to fix bad aliasing, but again the cure is worse than the disease. Make sure to get the separate v3 for episodes 487 and 490. Episode 517 is sourced from the BD. Episode 529 is randomly 24fps on most web sources so it's very stuttery (Old FUNI seems fine, at least the dub stream)

Episodes 575-578: 
F-R is JPN BD Encode+CR

Episodes 579-628:
-ZR- is JPN BD Remux+CR
F-R is JPN BD Encode+HatSubs (579-586), CR, and Yibis
JPN BD has terrible chroma again, but still beats web sources due to much better compression and FPS issues
Web sources have the wrong FPS for most of the season (24 instead of 30fps) resulting in extreme stutter. CR ENG/FUNI correct it at 601, CR JPN at 619, AMZN never

A more up to date WIP version of this can be found on the sheet. Site update soon ?
